summary: Stocks are down midday after a hot inflation report put another Fed rate hike back in play. Chip and AI-infrastructure names are leading the slide as investors question the cost and financing of the AI buildout.
market_note: S&P futures down about 1%, VIX up nearly 9%, and rate-hike chatter back after the inflation data.

items.why: Chip and AI-infrastructure names are retreating on cost and sustainability concerns over the AI buildout; CoreWeave is down over 12% on AI borrowing worries. Even a fresh BofA $720 price target could not stop the slide.
AI megacaps are slumping after the hot inflation print revived Fed rate-hike talk. Weakness across AI platforms and chips, including CoreWeave's plunge, is pressuring the whole AI complex.
Falling with AI names after its latest open-standard AI platform announcements failed to re-energize investors. Hot inflation data is also hitting the growth trade.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Growth and momentum names are bearing the brunt of the hot-inflation, rate-hike repricing.
